title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct beat frequency of 200 Hz.

title: Doppler Effect Application
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the relativistic Doppler effect to find the frequency received by the car.

title: Reflection Frequency Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student accurately calculates the frequency of the reflected signal as received by the radar.

title: Use of Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student correctly uses the speed of light and the velocity of the car in calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake or miscalculates the frequency shift due to the Doppler effect.
